title: Schedule a Tour or Inquire | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Schedule a tour of the barn at 437 Hio Ridge Road, Bridgton, Maine, or ask about a wedding or event date. Call or text 207.400.6353, or email Susan.
heading: Schedule a tour
lede: Tell us a little about your day and we will set up a private tour of the barn, the ell and the field. Or call or text Susan. She answers.

form.name: inquiry
form.privacy_line: We use what you send only to reply to you.

aside.heading: Or reach Susan directly
aside.reply_line: She replies by email or text, usually within a few days.
aside.directions: 437 Hio Ridge Road is a few minutes from downtown Bridgton. Turn in at the driveway; event parking is on the grass lot behind the tree line, and accessible parking is in the driveway. [CONFIRM: directions from Route 302]

thank_you.title: Thank you | R&SVP – Hio Ridge
thank_you.heading: Thank you
thank_you.body: Your message is on its way to Susan. She replies by email or text, usually within a few days. If it is urgent, call or text 207.400.6353.
